description: Migrate all container images for 15 production microservices from Docker Hub to a private Amazon ECR registry. For each service, pull the current image from Docker Hub, retag it with the ECR repository URI, push to ECR, update all Deployment and StatefulSet manifests to reference the new registry, and trigger a rolling restart. Verify that every service pod pulls successfully from ECR and serves traffic normally. Maintain the old Docker Hub references in a separate branch for instantaneous rollback if any service fails to pull or crashes after the migration.
